reviews.text: I'm building a pool with Robertson Pools and everything has been fantastic.  The designer Joe Cayton did a fabulous job interviewing us and understand our vision.  He designed a very pretty pool with a great water / fire feature.  The construction team has been very informative.  Marie communication has been great.
reviews.author: Nathan Courville

reviews.text: Great company.  I had a pool designed by Joe Cayton and everything was explained from design, to materials, schedule and the expectation for construction.  The masonry crew was fantastic and did a great job.  I never have seen better workmanship out of stone guys.  I would definitely recommend them to everyone.
reviews.author: Spencer CPA

reviews.text: We recently hired Robertson Pools to help design and build our spa addition/remodel to our existing pool. Kevin Dutra did an awesome job with our idea and gave us a great rendering of the remodel. Nic Hayden was our job superintendent. Nic did a great job staying on top of the project. Nic was very easy to talk to about any questions or concerns we had throughout the project. We’re a little over a month since they finished the project.  Nic is still answering questions I have on anything from maintenance to equipment. I put 1 before remodel and a few after remodel pictures. We are very happy with our pool Thank You Kevin, Nic and the crew at Robertson Pools.
reviews.author: David Grissom

reviews.text: Robertson Pools has the most responsive service department, and they were able to get me on the schedule for a repair quickly. They worked with my schedule and the technician that came out, Berek, was very knowledgeable and thorough, he got my pool up and running the same day with no further issues. The price was fair. 10/10 service all around, highly recommend.
reviews.author: Ashley Young

reviews.text: My wife and I hired Robertson Pools to design and build our new swimming pool, and we could not be happier! We work with Dave Campbell and his team, and they were extremely detail oriented, cost conscious, and informative throughout the process. Like any construction project, we faced obstacles along the way, but Dave and his team communicated with us and addressed problems as they came up. At the end of the day, we love our new pool!!
reviews.author: Eric Cates

reviews.text: We contracted Robertson Pools to resurface our pool and construct a retaining wall along our backyard patio. The workmanship was excellent! The construction crews were courteous and professional. Shout out to Marc who stopped by after everything was complete and went above and beyond to ensure that my wife and I were happy. Even though his team was backed up with service calls from last week's terrible winter storm, he stepped up and took care of our pool equipment that was damaged by the storm. I highly recommend Robertson's Pools for pool resurfacing and backyard improvements!
reviews.author: John Boldt

reviews.text: Robertson’s design and execution of our project exceeded our expectations. We are thrilled with our purchase. Having our project built during the pandemic while we know how busy and demanding the pool industry has been, we couldn’t be happier with the process and end product.
reviews.author: Kurt Duhamell

reviews.text: When building our pool I only considered bigger more well known companies even if they cost more to make sure we got the job done right. Unfortunately, even though I did this I am very displeased with Robertson today. Construction was an awful process. From the start of construction to the finish of the punch list it took 11-12 months. At one point in the process I called them because I hadn't seen them in so long and the lady on the phone admitted they forgot about me. During construction they messed up my driveway and refused to replace the damaged section. Even though we had these issues I didn't take the time to leave this review because we were just happy to finally have our pool done. What put me over the edge is that my waterline tiles began to fall off right after the 1 year mark of the pool completion. When I called Robertson to have them fix the problem, they told me it's only warranty it for a year and it would be no less than $750 to fix the handful of tiles that fell out. Even though I thought the price was ridiculous to fix some small tiles I decided to pay it so it would be done right and thought the tile problem was just a fluke. 5 months later I have had several more tiles continue to fall out. Their workmanship is obviously shotty and now I have to figure out what to do about my tile line that is slowly falling apart. Please keep in mind this pool isn't 20 years old, it's brand new. I definitely recommend you sign a pool contract with someone else.
reviews.author: Grant Romney

reviews.text:
Robertson Pools has built two pools for our family over the years, and the difference is in the final quality of their product! Neither was a giant pool, but they treated us like we were a big customer.

Tony Martin was our designer, who made the pools spectacular while within a reasonable budget. David Saulmon was our superintendent on both, and not only did he finish the projects without needing a punch list at the end, he also helped work through concerns with neighbors, and made sure everyone was happy! When we moved out of our first house, the Robertsons responded personally to help the new buyer with a question, which was the reason we came back to the team for our most recent pool.

Great job - it’s such a joy working with a family owned business where everyone cares so much about quality and stands behind the product!
reviews.author: Jenn Mack

reviews.text: Robertson resurfaced my pool with Pebbletec. Extremely pleased with the quality. Crews showed up as scheduled and cleaned up after themselves. My superintendant, Nic Hayden, was on top of all phases throughout the process and worked with my schedule. Job well done!
reviews.author: Michael Falkenstein

reviews.text: I enjoyed working with the Robertson Pools team on my new pool build, and couldn't be happier with the design, construction, and follow-up. The part that really impressed me is they have more in-house trades than anyone in the DFW metroplex, which really shows in the final build quality. From really clean masonry work to the gorgeous PebbleSheen finish, I really can't express how great this company is at building pools. Thanks for the amazing experience!
reviews.author: Amhet Hasan

reviews.text: We recently had Robertson Pools remodel our pool and also add an arbor and outdoor kitchen area.  Paul Geeslin and Marc Gordon were great to work with from the design process all the way through construction.  We are ecstatic with the final result and it was completely change our backyard experience.
reviews.author: David C.

reviews.text:
We just finished our pool build with Robertson. We interviewed several builders before deciding on Robertson and we are glad we did. They did have the best design but it was little things and attention to detail that made us go with Robertson.

The project was not perfect but what project of this size is?  What made me confident in our choice was the little things that can become big things. From the Rebar to the 2" piping to the proper equipment and quality of the electrical, Plumbing and Gunite. I have read to many horror stories where builders undersized the pumps, or used undersized piping or used ball joints instead of actuators. Robertson does it the right way.

There is also comfort in knowing of something does go wrong they will still be in business.

One last shout out David  our Project Manager.
reviews.author: Craig Valentine

reviews.text:
I just wanted to say how very much I appreciate our new Robertson Pools service person, Brad.  He is conscientious, professional and thorough, and I appreciate that he takes the extra few seconds with each week’s service to personalize his service notes/door hanger with each visit, instead of just checking the boxes and moving on. I also appreciate him noticing things that are not working and reporting those directly to Robertson’s as well as to me.

Robertson’s has been providing our weekly service since they built and installed our pool – while we’ve had plenty of reliable pool techs over that time, this is the first time that I’ve felt inclined to write about one, as he truly puts the “service” into your customer service and is an excellent representative of your company.   He’s a keeper, for sure!!
reviews.author: Maura Gast

reviews.text: Robertson built my pool 13 years ago.  I chose them because they gave me a beautiful design, and more pool for the money than their competition.  They also warranted the structure of the pool for life, which most companies don't.  When it came time to resurface the pool, I got quotes from several companies.  I had a structural crack, so I knew Robertson would have to repair that before any other company could do the resurfacing.  I also wanted to add a bench, and not all pool remodelers can do that.  In the end, Robertson basically met the best price I had, so I selected them.  Not everything went perfectly, which is pretty much the case in any construction/remodel project.  Communication was sometimes lacking, which left me frustrated when a one week job stretched out to three weeks.  When they were done, the pool looked great, but a mistake they made at the last minute left me with a patch in the wall that didn't match.  They told me to give it a while to see if the color would eventually match.  In the meantime, their equipment guy, Berek, and their start-up guy, Alex, showed me just how good their people are.  They went above and beyond in getting my pool ready to go.  But after two months, the patch was still very noticeable, so I sent an email to the owner, Ron Robertson, telling me how disappointed I was that they had made the mistake that required the patch in the first place.  I really didn't think they could do anything about it, but I wanted to let him know so maybe he could ensure that kind of thing doesn't happen again.  Instead, I get a call from them telling me they will come out and try to fix it.  They drained the pool (promising to reimburse me for the water), repatched it, and it looks great.  So even though things haven't been perfect, I give them 5 stars because they stand behind their work, and their people are great.
reviews.author: David Stewart

reviews.text: Hands down the most amazing people work here I called to get put on the schedule for a pool cleaning and Ashley in the service department was so helpful with getting it schedule in a timely manner very friendly and professional I highly recommend them and definitely will be using them again for all my pool needs as well.
reviews.author: Xander Faulk

reviews.text: I'm not a person who typically leaves reviews, but this was truly terrible customer service. The latest in a series of examples was gaslighting me into feeling like a ridiculous customer after I asked them to put everything on pause. They sent me an email saying they were coming out today, I called the tech's number on the email, and he said "idk what you're talking about I'm not coming to your house today". He then sent me a picture from my backyard 30 minutes later like nothing happened, saying "that's funny". Every single time they miscommunicated, or misrepresented their service offering, they gave me the attitude it was my fault and didn't own it.
reviews.author: Chris Nolan

reviews.text: Robertson replastered our pool a year ago, and the overall job management and communications were unprofessional and inconsistent. Items enumerated in the work order were ignored, and we were treated with condescension and a patronizing attitude on several occasions. The final result: a white plaster pool that started degrading within weeks after the resurfacing. We reached out several times to report this, and were told the discolorations were the result of improper chemical balance in the pool, so it was our fault. After the replastering our pool was serviced weekly, including brushing and maintaining proper chemistry. We've had three other pool plastering companies come to inspect and assess the issue. All independently confirmed the plastering job was done improperly and needed to be redone, confirming that in their opinion the obvious problems were not due to chemical imbalance or lack of maintenance. We recorded underwater video that clearly shows the defects and sent it to the company, requesting the owner come and confirm that this was what he expected a newly refinished Robertson Pool to look like. No response from the company. No response from the owner. $25K spent, and the pool looks much worse than before the replastering. Unfortunately we picked the wrong vendor.
reviews.author: Rush Beesley (Bees)

reviews.text: Extremely impressed with the amount of work we do in-house without subs. I always know who will be in the customers yard and can guarantee the quality of our workmanship.
reviews.author: Gerry Reynolds

reviews.text: Robertson pools has been the best weekly service company to work with. The community and communication has been amazing.
reviews.author: Kayli garza

reviews.text:
PLEASE READ THIS BEFORE MAKING ANY DECISION ABOUT DOING BUSINESS WITH ROBERTSON POOLS!
We have been a loyal customer for 18 years and just had the worst customer service experience I can remember!
We've spent over $100K with Robertson Pools - they designed, built and have exclusively serviced our pool since 2007 but - from the General Manager to the service tech - Rude - Surly and Unprofessional - beyond disappointing!!!
To Mr. Ron Robertson - As a business owner of over 35 yrs myself I would want to know how my loyal customers are being treated???
Buyer Beware
reviews.author: Damon Arthur

reviews.text: This was a huge project and very big investment into our home.  We enjoy it year around thanks to the great job done by Robertson Pools.  Aaron was great to work with, and we have no complaints after three years.
reviews.author: Aaron Carlson

reviews.text: We have a beautiful pool in University Park/Dallas that Robertson Pools built for our family 2 years ago.  We use Robertson’s for our weekly pool cleaning and maintenance as well.  They are very professional and always so helpful!  We absolutely love our pool!  We highly recommend this company to build and maintain your pool.  We are very pleased!!
reviews.author: D M

reviews.text: Exceptional job and nice, good natured people. Robertson Pools managed to make a big remodeling project feel like a sit back and relax kind of experience. Well planned, organized and executed. I think the key to their success is the kind of people they hire. Paul was very knowledgeable, fun to deal with, and extremely helpful in the decision making department. The demolition team was very fast, efficient, came up with a much better idea where to put the old stones that I wanted to keep, and cleaned all the mess really well before leaving. The coping and tile team was again very fast and efficient, convinced me to go with a much better design for my spa waterfall, and again very respectful to the property. The plaster team-same story plus a free concert when the whole team was singing  a song together:) And special thanks to Leo, their cleaning guy, who discovered the root ( turns out literally;)of my drainage problem under the pool decking. The whole remodeling was done in less than three weeks under Nick’s supervision, who was very professional, clear in his instructions, patient with me and my questions, always on site after each step of completion for quality check, and easy to reach. It wasn’t in Nick’s job description or part of the project to help me take out those impossible to take out drain covers, but he did it, just because that’s the kind of person he is. Good people, good job, good result. We absolutely love our newly remodeled pool and we would definitely recommend this company.
reviews.author: larissa dolt

reviews.text: Paul did a great job with our pool and bringing our vision to reality. Attention to detail was great and he was available and stopped by to check in through the entire process. My family and I are very pleased with the finished product and we are also happy with the timeline of the project.
reviews.author: Chris Mechsner

reviews.text:
To follow up on my previous post yesterday - I called Robertson Pools main office to speak to the owner that had responded to my post - Only to find out that the owner was not the one that responded as stated but the general manager which is who has escalated and continues to escalate this situation???
Secondly, I was insulted again and told that I was CRYING to the world. Exact words that were spoken to me by the general manager - I have it recorded:-)
Again, arrogant attitude!!!
Hopefully the real owners of the company will see these reviews for themselves and get back with me - again an 18 year loyal customer!
One of the most regrettable things is that I have recommended Robertson Pools to so many people for so many years!?!?
reviews.author: Damon Arthur

reviews.text: Robertson Pools recently remodeled my pool and met or exceeded all my expectations! I was very happy with the Customer experience and we are amazed with the beautiful outcome. Tile, plaster and re-grouting our coping was orchestrated by some great crews, not to mention some individual expertise replacing our traditional lighting with new led color lights and a variable speed pump. I loved the team work I witnessed from Nic’s leadership as Superintendent. Standouts included: Nic, Kito, Alex and Chad. Dave and the back-office office support staff were very responsive to all our needs relative to scheduling and weather factors. Put simply, I believe Ron Robertson has put together a winning team specializing in remodeling/restoration and highly recommend them if you want your pool to look new again!
reviews.author: Matt Buckley

reviews.text: Service was great from start to finish. Highly recommend. Paul was Amazing to work with.
reviews.author: William Price

reviews.text:
Assessed several pool builders and opted to go with Robertson for several reasons. 1) They provided me with our favorite design and were great about incorporating different/key items we requested- anyone could have built the plan but this was a weighing factor. 2) Their technique for spas is second to none. No other builder had a solution like theirs for the coping hitting your neck and not only was this standard issue for Robertson but its also a perfect solution now that I have used my spa! 3) Their pricing and negotiation was fair and competitive. 4) The build process went smoothly and we enjoyed working with the foreman. He was easy to work with and easy to get in touch with for questions and needs. I felt the timing was well executed and the communication was also excellent. 5) Pool school was very very through! 6)Calling into the office for service, warranty or any general home owner question has proven to be easy- the staff is always able to advise, answer or help. The turn around time for filter cleaning, etc has been excellent as well.

I really cannot say enough about my experience with Robertson. It was refreshing to have such a seamless experience after having worked with and heard about so many shady companies and contractors around the home building side. I would recommend Robertson 100% to anyone and would not hesitate to say that you will not be disappointed.

My only issue was that I had a personnel problem which I contacted the office about and asked that the GM/owner contact me back. No one ever did and that really bothered me after I took the time out to reach out.
reviews.author: Jenn

reviews.text: Micah and Colton did a great job and were really nice to work with. We did a minor remodel (fixed some loose coping stones, put a spillway topper on, fixed some grout joints and did new mastic around the entire pool deck).  We didn't like the way they cut a couple of the new stones so they redid them to our liking, with no issue at all and let us pick which stones we wanted (to make sure they matched).  Robertson built our pool 17 years ago and did a great job and that's why we had them back. We would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Kevin C

reviews.text: We could not be more pleased with the entire process in Robertson Pools.  Kevin was amazing with his insight and initial design process.  Fabulous to work with, listened to our wants and then made it even better.  David was on site and took care of everything.  His communication was top notch and we always knew what to expect for next steps and timing.  Highly recommend!
reviews.author: kelly cunningham

reviews.text:
The design experience and prices/value were comparable to most others. The installation took twice as long as the "worst case" schedule.  Some issues with light fixtures failing, but they did replace them.  Sod installation was poor, full of uneven ground.  The "SunDek" coating failed and began to flake and peel while still under warranty, they replaced and corrected half of it under warranty but left the other half to continue to fail. While waiting the warranty expired and now they refuse to fix it.

In addressing the inaccurate response, the pool construction was completed in January of 19. So the warranty certainly did not expire then.

This first issue began in 2021 and I notified Robertson at that time, October of 21. I have emails documenting this time frame. Then half of it was repaired, leaving the other half still failing, still under warranty but just ignored. It is inaccurate to say "fall of 2023" as incorrectly noted below. It's taken until now winter of 2024 to have it acknowledged, since I've posted it publicly finally.  Additionally, Robertson offered once to correct their error, and I was not even given a cost to even consider. Not "on many occasions".
reviews.author: Rich Egoville

reviews.text: After a thorough process of due diligence, reviewing proposals and interviews, we chose Robertson Pools to build our new pool and are quite happy that we did. Although we had a few glitches with the design process and communication of that information to the build team, once that was ironed out, everything went extremely well. the quality of work was top notch and the pool was completed on time. We have been enjoying the pool for 5 months now and could not be happier with the final product and how easy it is to operate and maintain. I highly recommend paying extra for the in-ground cleaning system. No annoying sweeper crawling around and we have yet to sweep up a single thing from the bottom of the pool even after big storms drop debris in the pool. We would definitely use Robertson again.
reviews.author: Matthew Cordner

reviews.text:
1.  These guys took over our swampy pool that the previous company could not clear, and made it pristine within a week…at half the cost.

2.  Although they could have sold me a $1200 gadget that I even asked for, they showed me how to operate the pool pump without it.

I so frequently feel that I am being upsold or even frankly lied to by techs and workman, but JP has restored my faith.
reviews.author: carolyn lyde

reviews.text:
Robertson’s built our pool last year.  Initially things started okay, but during pool layout, A big problem was found in the design and drawings. The elevations were off and the pool was misaligned with the house.  Thankfully these issues were fixed and the design corrected.

Pool construction took much longer than planned. Even that was understandable, given how many pools they were building. Unfortunately, as soon as they had the last check for start up they stopped answering calls or responding to emails.   I turned in my punch list with numerous items listed, and they still have not been finished after 10 months.

There is tile work that isn’t up to standards. Decking with numerous flaws, and an area of drainage in the yard that pools water.

The worst part is, they keep ignoring my calls and emails.

I’m sad to say that I’m extremely disappointed in their customer service.
reviews.author: Chris Aday

reviews.text:
This is the 2nd pool Robertsons has built for us. We did not think it possible for them to top our first experience, but they have! We love our new pool, spa, and outdoor living space. The project turned out exactly how we envisioned it!

Kudos to Marie, our inside coordinator and Truett, our superintendent, they have been the best!  Both are professional and do what they say they are going to do, when they say they are going to do it!  Marie’s customer service is exemplary, and I feel she goes the extra mile for her customers. Truett is great with communicating during the project.  He is very knowledgeable and has an uncanny ability to stay calm in all situations which instills confidence in his clients.

One of the things that sold us on using Robertsons again after talking to several comparable pool companies is the fact that they do not sub out their work to outside contractors. We found this to be valuable in not only the timeframe in getting our pool completed, but also the professionalism at each phase of the project. I highly recommend Robertsons Pools!
reviews.author: Marylee Jeske

reviews.text: I have worked with Robertson Pools for years.  I have had my home for over 20 years and had them re-plaster our pool twice.  They give clear expectations and meet their deadlines for work. Shout out to Dave Campbell and Jerry Reynolds for their professional work.  Thank you and I would recommend them to anyone.
reviews.author: Shane Kimbrel

reviews.text:
Dave, cannot say enough good things about Tony Martin and David Saulmon regarding our pool purchase and construction.

Tony gave us a competitive price and told us what to expect.  He guided us through the selection process and made recommendations.  Tony was very adaptive on the contract when we wanted to change accountability for the sprinklers.  He allowed us to remove it, issued a credit, and allowed us to use our own landscaper.  Tony said to expect 3 months to complete which is about how long it took.  Tony was a professional and it showed when compared to other companies.  There sales people made us feel like we were buying a used car.

David kept us up to date on the crews and timing.  The stone work is amazing and now I understand the time involved creating a one of a kind feature.  David always responded almost immediately to our questions and always had answers.  Anita was super and kept us abreast of the schedule changes.  The  "Pool Builder" app is amazing.  It saved a lot more calls to David regarding the pool's  status.

Dave, as a customer you hear horror stories about pool building and some of the Google Robinson Reviews had us worried when making our decision on whom to use.  Your leaders and crews are amazing.  Love the final product and wanted to share our experience.  Would definitely recommend Robertson Pools to others.

Sincerely, Joe and Sally Sagel.
